correctness.rationale: An explicit orbit-face PL model gives all simplices, with a flag-compatible table. The two-layer base has H1=Z^{N-1}, H3=Z^{2c_m}, pi1 free N-1, and vanishing H2. Each orbit cone link is two simplices joined by m+1 cross edges, with H1=Z^m. The integral boundary from mN relative 2-classes surjects onto H1 of base via edge differences along connected Q_m. The kernel is free rank (m-1)N+1; relative higher groups vanish. Van Kampen kills all pi1 generators. Case n=2 is a filled triangle. A standalone standard-library exhaustive finite GF2 checker corroborates n=2..7, without being mistaken for proof.

value.rationale: Coordinate transpositions are elementary, natural symmetries of hypercube metrics. A complete integral and simply-connected fixed-space calculation identifies large degree-two classes invisible in the ambient degree-three homology, and discriminates geometric fixed-point strata from invariant-vertex subcomplexes. The result is an infinite, parameter-exact structural classification, not a parameter substitution or routine known-table computation.
